questions.q: Why was that year called the Year of Sorrow?
options: Because Abu Talib and Khadijah died and the Prophet SAW was deeply grieved
questions.explain: The Year of Sorrow was the year Abu Talib and Khadijah died.

questions.q: What was Abu Talib's real name?
questions.explain: Abu Talib looked after him from the age of eight.

questions.q: Who handled the burial of Abu Talib on the Prophet's SAW instruction?
questions.explain: Ali embraced Islam at seven and handled his father's burial.

questions.q: According to Al-Qasas 28:56, who holds guidance?
questions.explain: Allah makes clear that guidance is His alone. Even the Prophet SAW could not force someone he loved.

questions.q: What was Khadijah's role for the Prophet SAW after he was insulted?
options: She was the place he came home to be comforted

questions.explain: The Prophet SAW shrouded and buried her at Al-Ma'allah, the cemetery of Makkah.

questions.q: About how old was Fatimah when her mother died?
questions.explain: Fatimah was still small when her mother died.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW could force someone he loved to embrace Islam.
questions.explain: False. Guidance belongs to Allah. Our job is only to convey.

questions.q: After Khadijah died, the Prophet SAW gave gifts to her friends and always praised her.
questions.explain: True. He remembered and honoured those who had done good.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.
questions.explain: The boycott ended, Abu Talib fell ill and died, then Khadijah died, and he remembered her.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The state of being near death
The year Abu Talib and Khadijah died

questions.explain: The Year of Sorrow was the year of both deaths, nazak is near death, hidayah is guidance from Allah, and Al-Ma'allah is the Makkan cemetery.

questions.q: We were born into Muslim families. How should we speak to someone struggling with family who are not yet Muslim?
options: Talk lightly as though it is nothing
Speak with compassion and be grateful for our ease
questions.explain: New Muslims struggle because loved ones are not yet Muslim, so speak with compassion.
